# `tenant`

Customer tenant: the root of every isolation boundary.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Owner module | platform |
| Kind | aggregate-root |
| Tenant scope | Not tenant scoped |
| Runtime access | Granted to runtime roles (see migration grants) |
| Effective / recorded time | `created_at` |
| Retention class | `tenant-account`: Life of the customer contract plus the offboarding retention period (SAS-03, SAS-04). Period: not yet decided. |
| API mapping | /v1/tenant (planned, read-only for tenant users) |
| Write path | provision_tenant() via the platform role only. |
| Migration behaviour | Created in 0001_foundation (expand). |

## Constraints

- PK (id)
- name 1-200 chars
- environment in (production, sandbox)
- status in (active, suspended)
- version >= 1, must advance by exactly 1 per update
- insert/update requires an audit event in the same transaction
